Giving up Park Place hands P2 the dark blue monopoly, which is a big concession for just $400 cash plus a $350 Reading Railroad-ish property — I'm weighing whether to push for more cash or trade for Indiana Avenue instead.

Actually Indiana's not useful since I don't need reds. If I demand $700 plus Penn RR, that leaves P2 only ~$536, capping their building to about two houses, which blunts the threat while giving me enough cash to chase Vermont. I'll counter at $700 plus Penn RR.
